requestedIntent: Separate ACEF execution depth from risk assurance so Guarded adds controls without duplicating BMAD or turning compact work into the Full lifecycle.
limitations: Direct compatibility remains readable during the installed-project upgrade bridge, but new Direct admission is still rejected.
Legacy active runs with lane guarded are intentionally fail-closed until a human selects the missing execution workflow.
The capability is enforced in this source tree; target repositories must update their installed ACEF tools and hooks before they receive it.
Deterministic Stage 0 passed 6/6. Neither the first P0 pair nor the clean v2 candidate rerun produced an eligible process-and-product PASS. This capability remains enforced, not proven or installed.

The clean v2 candidate rerun completed in 11,174.7 active seconds with a green integration command but correctly failed closeout. Its 25 expected and 26 observed actor invocations are retained as recovery evidence; the versioned v3 treatment must pass before controlled-canary promotion.

New intake decisions carry routingPolicyVersion two-axis-v1. Under that policy, risk-only Full selection fails lane-selection; a proven bounded defect can use ACEF Fix + Guarded, while explicit planning/scope triggers still require Full. Existing intake records without the version retain compatibility behavior.

A migrated compatibility Full run may record terminal FAIL, REPLAN, or BLOCKED without retroactively satisfying stale lifecycle state. This is not certification: the commit is limited to the active-run record and its exactly bound terminal gate, and cannot include application changes.

evidence.note: Exercises all three workflows under Baseline and Guarded, proves the overlay is monotonic, accepts a proven bounded billing/subscription/public-auth defect as Fix + Guarded, rejects risk-only Full over-routing, and admits Full after a new-contract trigger.
